author: Brett Alan
title: Does Anyone Have A More Popular Jersey Than Josh Allen? - NewsBreak
text:
By Brett Alan ,
7 hours ago
Josh Allen is one of the most popular players in the NFL, so does anyone sell more jerseys than he does?
You see a lot of Bills’ #17 jerseys in the New York area, but when it comes to sales across the country, who has the most popular jersey? Do you think you have a guess?
The NFLPA’s List Of The Most Popular Jerseys The NFLPA (National Football League Players Association) has released the list of the 50 most popular jerseys in the country when it comes to NFL jersey sales. The list is based on the results of “sales of NFL Player jerseys, officially licensed by Fanatics as reported by the NFLPA from March 1 – July 31, 2025″
The player with the highest jersey sales is Philadelphia Eagles star running back Saquon Barkley. The second player on the list is also from the Philadelphia Eagles. It’s Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts. Jayden Daniels (who had an incredible year last season) is at number 3 on the list, followed by the 2025 NFL MVP quarterback of the Buffalo Bills, Josh Allen.
Josh Allen has the 4th most popular jersey To some, especially in Buffalo, it might be surprising that not everyone loves Josh Allen. He’s easily coming off his best year ever with what many would argue was one of his least talented rosters. He suddenly on a ton of commercials and after marrying a Hollywood star, you’re beginning to see more and more of him.
But he’s not on all of their teams. He plays for the Buffalo Bills and there’s a good chance that he found a way to beat most of the rest of these teams. Plus, the two people with the most popular jerseys in America both just won the Super Bowl last season.
We are just one week in. It will be interesting to see who will lead sales at the end of the season.
